source: Design for Motion Universal 16-Point Production QA Rubric (Style-Agnostic)

items.name: Brief & Spec Alignment
items.passCriteria: brief.json declares concept, format specs, OKLCH colorScript, and beat plan, and all referenced scene files exist.

items.name: Concept & Form Unity
items.passCriteria: Visual language grows organically from the content with clear Reduction and Amplification — never a recycled template.

items.name: Narrative Tension & Pacing
items.passCriteria: Clear conceptual tension pair with varied beat energy across the timeline — never a flat rhythm.

items.name: Visual Hierarchy & Pure Cinema Frame
items.passCriteria: Each frame has a clear primary focal point with clean reading order and zero slide-deck chrome (no corner pagination or numbered section eyebrows).

items.name: Positive & Negative Space Balance
items.passCriteria: Space balance fits the chosen visual medium — generous breathing room for minimalist work, clear sightlines for dense collage.

items.name: Symmetry & Asymmetry Rhythm
items.passCriteria: Composition balance serves the narrative intent across beats rather than repeating a rigid centered layout.

items.name: Grayscale Value Separation
items.passCriteria: In grayscale preview on review-board.png, figure/ground luminance separates cleanly without muddy mid-gray collapse.

items.name: Color Script & Chroma Discipline
items.passCriteria: Follows an intentional color harmony and 60-30-10 chroma budget (reserving high saturation for focal moments, avoiding default software UI palettes).

items.name: Depth & Visual Layering
items.passCriteria: Whether 2D or 3D, foreground/midground/background separate cleanly via value, scale, occlusion, perspective, or lighting.

items.name: Shot Scale & Framing Variety
items.passCriteria: Varied framing and scale progression across beats rather than locking the entire film to one static shot size.

items.name: Deterministic Motion & Continuity
items.passCriteria: Strictly driven by window.film.frame(t) with zero rAF/Math.random(); continuous visual motion visible across beats.

items.name: Whole-Board Belonging
items.passCriteria: Across review-board.png, all beats unmistakably belong to the same cohesive film world.

items.name: Typography Casting & Single-Track Captions
items.passCriteria: Typeface matches content voice with crisp kerning/integration; no double subtitles colliding with OpenFilm's native .vtt caption track.

items.name: Render Performance & Craft Finish
items.passCriteria: No per-frame layout-thrashing style mutations (top/left/width/height); clean edges, lighting, and tactile finish.

items.name: Viewport Clipping & Safe Zones
items.passCriteria: Zero unintended viewport clipping and zero focal-element safe-zone violations.

items.name: OpenFilm Delivery & Zero-Crash Sweep
items.passCriteria: Exports window.film = { duration, ready, frame(t) }, passes full-timeline 0.25s exception sweep with zero errors, and has no blank opening frame.
